gloss: consolation group; goodwill delegation; morale-boosting group

definitions.gloss: consolation group; goodwill delegation; morale-boosting group
definitions.explanation: An organized group that visits people in difficult circumstances — such as soldiers, disaster victims, hospital patients, or those in care facilities — to offer encouragement, comfort, and often entertainment.

examples.japanese: {慰問団|いもんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: A consolation group visited the hospital.

examples.japanese: {慰問団|いもんだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧や⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{披露|ひろう}した→披露する：20927_hirousuru⟧。
examples.english: The goodwill delegation performed songs and music in the disaster area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦時中|せんじちゅう}→戦時中：28629_senjichuu⟧、⟦{芸能人|げいのうじん}→芸能人：14959_geinoujin⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{慰問団|いもんだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{前線|ぜんせん}→前線：11791_zensen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{励|はげ}まし→励ます：05304_hagemasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: During the war, entertainment troupes went to the front lines to encourage the soldiers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{慰問|いもん}→慰問：24089_imon⟧ (consolation visit) and ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (group, troupe). The concept of ⟦{慰問|いもん}→慰問：24089_imon⟧ involves visiting people who are suffering or in hardship to offer comfort and encouragement. In modern Japan, {慰問団|いもんだん} activities include visiting elderly care facilities, hospitals, and disaster-affected areas, often with musical performances or other entertainment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慰問団|いもんだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispatch a consolation group
- {慰問団|いもんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧: a visit by a consolation group
- {慰問団|いもんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to join a consolation group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{慰問|いもん}→慰問：24089_imon⟧: consolation visit — the act itself rather than the group
- {訪問団|ほうもんだん}: visiting delegation — a broader term without the consolation nuance
- {使節団|しせつだん}: diplomatic mission — a formal delegation representing an organization or country
